items.title: Dollar General (DG) Faces FTC And State Consumer Privacy Lawsuit
items.summary: Dollar General (NYSE:DG) has been sued by the Federal Trade Commission and multiple states over alleged consumer protection and privacy violations. The complaint accuses the retailer of breaching federal and state statutes that govern how shoppers are treated and how their data is handled. Regulators are seeking both monetary penalties and court orders that could restrict certain business practices across Dollar General's store network and digital channels.
